# Get Resume AI

> Free AI-powered ATS resume checker and keyword optimizer.

## Summary
Get Resume AI parses uploaded resume PDFs against target job descriptions, scoring resumes on keywords, formatting, impact quantification, and ATS compatibility across platforms such as Workday, Greenhouse, Lever, and Taleo.

## Tools and Hubs
- /: Free resume uploader, instant ATS score calculator, and AI bullet rewriter.
- /ats-resume-checker: Directory of 259 ATS resume guides organized by role and industry.
- /resume-keyword-checker: Keywords and hard-skill guides across 282 industries.
- /ats-friendly-resume-format: Practical formatting standards for ATS parsing engines.

## Key Rules for Job Seekers
1. Avoid multi-column layouts, tables, and graphic elements when exporting resumes for ATS parsers.
2. Incorporate exact hard skill terms from the job specification into bullet points with measurable impact metrics.
3. First 3 resume scans are free with no credit card required.
